summary: 非限制性定语从句、介词 + 关系代词、as 引导的定语从句，以及 that/which 的使用限制。
signals: 逗号隔开 → 非限制性（不用 that）

rules.title: 限制性 vs 非限制性定语从句
rules.detail: 非限制性定语从句用逗号与主句隔开，作补充说明，不能用 that 引导，关系词不可省略。

examples.en: I have a brother who works in Beijing.（可能有多个兄弟）
examples.zh: 我有一个在北京工作的哥哥。

examples.en: I have a brother, who works in Beijing.（只有一个哥哥，补充说明）
examples.zh: 我有一个哥哥，他在北京工作。

rules.title: 介词 + 关系代词：in which / of which / with whom...
rules.detail: 介词的选择取决于从句动词的搭配或先行词。in which = where；for whom = for whom...。介词后不能用 that 和 who。

examples.en: This is the house in which Lu Xun once lived. (= where)
examples.zh: 这是鲁迅曾经住过的房子。

examples.en: The man to whom you spoke is my uncle.
examples.zh: 和你说话的那个人是我叔叔。

rules.title: 只能用 that 的五种情况
rules.detail: 先行词被 ① 序数词 ② 最高级 ③ the only / the very ④ all / everything / nothing 等不定代词 ⑤ 既有人又有物 修饰时，关系词用 that。

examples.en: All that glitters is not gold.
He talked about the people and the things that interested him.
examples.zh: 他谈论了让他感兴趣的人和事。

rules.title: as 引导的非限制性定语从句
rules.detail: as 可以指代整个主句，位置灵活（句首/句中/句尾），常用于 as we all know, as is often the case。

examples.en: As we all know, the earth goes around the sun.
examples.zh: 众所周知，地球绕着太阳转。

pitfalls: 非限制性从句用 that：❌ The book, that I bought yesterday, is good. → ✓ The book, which I bought yesterday, is good.
介词后用 that：❌ the room in that he lives → ✓ the room in which he lives
that 不能引导非限制性从句，whose 指物时 = of which

questions.stem: Mount Tai, ___ is in Shandong Province, attracts many visitors.
questions.explain: 非限制性定语从句（有逗号）且先行词是物，用 which，不能用 that。

questions.stem: The house ___ roof was damaged has been repaired.
questions.explain: roof 前缺定语「房子的」，用 whose roof = the roof of which。

questions.stem: This is the museum ___ we took many photos last year.
questions.explain: 在博物馆里「拍照」用 in the museum，故介词+关系代词 in which = where。

questions.stem: ___ is often the case, he was late for the meeting again.
questions.explain: as is often the case 固定表达「像往常一样」，as 指代整个主句且可位于句首。

questions.stem: Everything ___ can be done has been done. (关系代词)
questions.explain: 先行词是 everything，关系词只能用 that。

questions.stem: The engineer with ___ my father works is about fifty. (关系代词)
questions.explain: 介词 with 后指人只能用 whom：with whom my father works。

questions.stem: The novel, that was written by Mo Yan, is very popular.
questions.explain: 非限制性定语从句（有逗号）不能用 that 引导，改为 which。

questions.stem: 正如报纸上报道的那样，这个城市建造了一座新桥。（翻译整句）
answer: as is reported in the newspaper, a new bridge has been built in the city.
questions.explain: as 指代整个主句并置于句首：As is reported...。

questions.stem: 我们工作的那家公司是三年前成立的。（翻译整句）
answer: the company (that/which) we work for was set up three years ago.
the company for which we work was set up three years ago.
questions.explain: work for 的 for 可提前构成 for which；或用 that/which 并保留介词在后。
